snippet.title: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream Direct 1.29.2026
snippet.description:
Join us on Jan 29 at 6am PT for the Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream Direct! The presentation will last roughly 20 minutes and provide more info on the upcoming Nintendo Switch game.

Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream releases for Nintendo Switch on April 16, 2026. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/tomodachi-life-living-the-dream-switch/?utm_source=SW-AA&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=N1151-01&utm_id=N1151-01
 
#TomodachiLife #NintendoDirect
